spans.s:
ind.
1 Expression of disregard or contempt, (Phoo, hoot.)
2 Imitative sound, implying the bubbling or boiling of water &c. or of blowing into any liquid.
E.
स्फुर to swell, aff. क्विप्, स rejected, and तुक् added, form irr.

ind.
Imitative sound of bubbling, sobbing, &c.: see फुत्.

m. (-रः)
Fire.
E.
फुत् boiling, and कर who makes.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Arrogant, contemptuous, disdainful.
m. (-रः)
1 The sound of bubbling, &c.
2 Blowing or breathing into, (as to cool it.)
E.
फुत् expression of contempt, and कार who makes.

Blowing or breathing into any liquid.
E.
फूत्, and कार making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Blown up, (as a bubble.)
2 Blown into, cooled by blowing into it.
E.
फुत्, and कृत made.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bubbled, bubbling, made to sound so.
2 Blown or breathed into, (a liquid.)
3 Sounded as in sobbing.
E.
फूत्, and कृत made.
